sources.title: 3G and 2G switch-off
sources.evidence_location: official HTML status and expectations sections
facts: All four UK MNOs are described as having completed 3G switch-off
Operators retain responsibility for their own 2G timing
limitations: Expectations are not evidence of compliance everywhere
Mobile transition is separate from fixed internet access

sources.title: Switching off 2G and 3G networks: advice for IoT and third-party device suppliers
sources.evidence_kind: IoT and third-party device transition guidance
facts: The page states UK 3G networks are switched off
It addresses IoT and third-party device suppliers
limitations: Supplier guidance is not device certification
The page does not establish local coverage

sources.title: 3G 'not-spot' data: network switch-off update

facts: Page discusses properties potentially losing reliable indoor 3G-only service
It identifies continuity responsibilities for services such as telecare
limitations: Postcode risk is not exact parcel coverage
